svg.text: VSEISMO carrier board, schematic rev A (design reference, not for fabrication)
Net-label style: same blue label = same net. Pin numbers in grey. Power comes from the EQAMP J8 (raw DC), so the power return already joins AMP_GND and GND.
A. Power: raw DC from EQAMP J8, U1 makes 5 V, U2 makes a clean 3.3 V for the ADC
One adapter (18-24 V DC) feeds the EQAMP. P1 takes
its J8 raw DC (after its bridge, before its
regulators): about 15-27 V. Never its J9 +-12 V.
D1 P6KE30A (25.6 V standoff) for adapters up to
24 V; P6KE33A for 28 V. D3 is redundant behind
D2: the DevKit never fights its own USB 5 V. +3V3A feeds only the Click (AVDD = DVDD there).
B. ESP32-C5-DevKitC-1 v1.2 (DK1) on two 1x16 female headers
UART0 (J3-2/3) stays free: the WinSDR stream goes out the DevKit's USB-UART port.
GPIO25/26 (strapping) unused. Check J1/J3 against your board and the Espressif
Dimensions v1.2 DXF before ordering (changed from order PW-2025-04-0446).
C. MikroE ADC 15 Click (ADS131M02) on mikroBUS-pattern sockets J4 / J5
x not fed: the Click runs on 3.3V
33R series resistors sit at the driving end: R10, R11, R13, R15, R16 next to the DevKit,
R12 (MISO) and R14 (DRDY) next to the Click. The Click has its own 4.7k pull-ups on RST, CS,
PWM (CS2) and INT (DRDY), all to its VCC = +3V3A. PWM drives the LTC6903 SEN pin.
The analog inputs are NOT on mikroBUS: they are the Click's own TB1 / TB2 screw terminals,
wired from P4 and P5 (section D). CLKIN comes from P6 (section E) after the trace cut.
mikroBUS sockets: 2 x 1x8, 22.86 mm row spacing. Check against the MikroE mikroBUS spec
and the ADC 15 Click drawing before ordering.
D. Analog front end: one block per EQAMP channel, +-10 V to +-0.99 V, to the Click
Each EQAMP channel output is a 2-pin pair (signal, ground). Each one keeps its pair all the way to
its ADC input: signal through the divider to AINx+, the channel's own ground return to AINx-.
R30 DNP: the J8 power return already joins AMP_GND and GND. Fit 10R only if hum shows up. Ratio 0.099:
+-10 V -> +-0.99 V. No clamp diodes: a clamp to GND would clip the negative half. TB2 is AIN1-, AIN1+ on the Click.
E. ADC clock: 8.192 MHz oscillator or ESP32 LEDC, to the Click CLKIN pad
JP1 1-2: oscillator (exactly 1000 SPS at OSR 4096). 2-3: GPIO7 LEDC, 8.000 MHz. Open: stock LTC6903,
P6 unwired and the Click trace left intact. Y1 EN: open or high = running, R31 holds it high.
F. Timing: DS3231 (ZS-042) and GPS PPS, one of them to GPIO23
ZS-042 brings its own 4.7k pull-ups on SCL, SDA and SQW,
so R40/R41 stay DNP. 32K unused. Its charge circuit
needs an LIR2032, or remove its diode for a CR2032.
C13 100nF at J2 VCC. R40, R41 4.7k DNP (SDA, SCL to +3V3).
JP2 1-2: DS3231 SQW, 2-3: GPS PPS. R43 makes a 1k/2.2k divider for a 5 V PPS.
P7 +5V powers the GPS module (u-blox class boards take 3.3-5 V).
G. Spare GPIO, test points, mounting
IO2 and IO3 are strapping pins on some DevKit revisions: inputs or late outputs only.
Test points (1x40 header pieces): TP1 +VIN, TP2 +5V, TP3 +3V3, TP4 +3V3A, TP5 GND, TP6 CLKIN.
Four M3 holes, nylon standoffs. Board 130 x 90 mm, 2 layers.
